title: Patch: the AI's threat math drops a unit its own Burn or Toxic destroys before it can attack, and counts The Banisher's hit on a Unit as an exile

**Issue #4065 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4065: Patch: the AI's threat math drops a unit its own Burn or Toxic destroys before it can attack, and counts The Banisher's hit on a Unit as an exile
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The computer opponent guesses which enemy units will live to attack next turn and which fights kill what. It gets two common situations wrong.

- **Units that burn to death first.** A unit carrying enough Burn or Toxic to die at the start of its own turn dies before it can attack, but the AI still counts it as an attacker. Say the AI's Scorch has burned an enemy 4/4 that stands beside a 3/3, and the AI is at 7 life. The AI believes it faces 7 damage, when only 3 can come. It already gets this right for units that crumble from Brittle.
- **The Banisher.** This one-mana Common exiles any Unit it damages, but the AI treats its hit as 2 ordinary damage. So the AI thinks its own 5/5 can attack The Banisher for free, and it misses that an enemy Banisher can remove its big Taunt.

After the fix, the AI's quick reads match the game in both cases. Players see fewer needless defensive turns, and big units stop being fed to a 2/1.

## Why

**Burn and Toxic.**
- They tick in the start stage of their controller's turn, before the main phase (R3540001, `crates/engine/src/turn.rs:414`). Burn's damage meets Armor; Toxic's pierces it. A unit the first tick destroys never attacks.
- `face_threat_from` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1166-1198`) and `could_attack_next_turn` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:1043-1049`) skip only a unit its own Brittle tick destroys (`crumbles_before_swing`, `evaluate.rs:153`, R3793000).
- The evaluation already works out which tick kills a unit (`afflicted`, `evaluate.rs:472`, R3822000), but it uses that only to lower the unit's worth, never its threat.
- Burn and Toxic come from cards that have been in the AI's decks since R3574000:
  - S+ #37 Scorch, a Common whose damage also Burns 5 (Radiant 10);
  - S+ #117 Zenith, #118 Antumbra, #119 Eclipse and #114 Reign, whose damage Burns 3 to 5;
  - S+ #121 Toxopid;
  - the burn verbs.

**The Banisher** (Meditative #72, Common, a 1-mana 2/1: Whenever this damages a Unit, exile that Unit).
- Any Unit it deals 1 or more to is marked, and the next state check exiles it ahead of deaths. No Death fires and Reborn does not bring it back (R1124, `crates/engine/src/damage.rs:771-779`).
- The AI reads its hits as plain damage. `blow` and `kills_and_survives` (`candidates.rs:220`, `:281`) know Poisonous but not `exiles_on_damage`, and the Taunt walk ends a Taunt early only for Poisonous (`evaluate.rs:1404`).
- So the move order ranks an attack into The Banisher as a kill the attacker survives. And the opponent model's static trader (`reply.rs:83`, `:118`) prices an enemy Banisher's swing as 2 chip damage, never as the removal it is.

**Not covered elsewhere.** No open issue covers either case. #3909 taught the threat count Scorch's attack-across rule, and #3793 Brittle's crumble, but not a unit's own tick or the exile. The board's combat forecast misses the exile too (`crates/engine/src/query.rs:1067-1068`); that is the engine's and the client's side and is left out here.

## Proposal

1. **Units destroyed by their own tick.** Extend `crumbles_before_swing`, or add a sibling its two callers also ask, so that a unit destroyed by the next tick of its own Burn and Toxic, before its controller's next attacks, counts as gone.
   - Read that tick as `afflicted` reads it: Burn through Armor, Toxic piercing, the unit's own damage cap, and Divine Shield or Indestructible stopping it.
   - Take the timing from `crumbles_before_swing`: the player on turn keeps this turn's attacks.
2. **The Banisher's exile.** Treat a hit from a source with `exiles_on_damage` like a Poisonous hit everywhere the AI computes one: `exchange`'s sides, `blow`, `kills_and_survives`, `fight`, the Taunt walk and its Cleave splash, `falls_to_first_strike`. Dealing 1 or more to a Unit removes it.
   - Price the removal as an exile: the whole unit, no Death left behind, no Reborn body back.
   - A hit stopped by Divine Shield, Indestructible or the zero rule exiles nothing.
3. **Behind `AI_EVAL` flags**, off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, as R3793000's was. Each decision the spec does not settle gets a ruling in the issue's block, a proving test and a §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. One example to settle: whether a unit with unspent Reborn that its tick destroys still threatens.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: `crumbles_before_swing`, `face_threat_from`, the Taunt walk, `falls_to_first_strike`, `kill_worth`'s callers
- `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`: `could_attack_next_turn`, `blow`, `kills_and_survives`
- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`: `exchange`, `fight`, `trade_value`
- `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: the flags
- Tests under `crates/ai/tests/ai/` (beside `brittle.rs`, plus a module for the exile), and `crates/ai/README.md`
- SPEC §4.4 step 7, §4.5 step 1, §6.3 (Burn and Toxic), §9.9 (Evaluation); R1124, R3540001, R3793000, R3822000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An enemy 4/4 with Burn 5 beside an enemy 3/3, both in Attack Position, with the seat at 7 life: `face_threat` reads 3, and `could_attack_next_turn` is false for the 4/4. With Burn 3, it reads 7.
- [ ] Burn 5 on a 4/4 with Armor 2 deals 3 and leaves it standing, so it still counts. Toxic 4 on the same unit pierces and destroys it, so it does not.
- [ ] A burning unit that is Indestructible, or holds an unspent Divine Shield, still counts. So does one whose controller is on turn with this turn's attacks to come.
- [ ] The seat's 5/5 against an enemy The Banisher: `kills_and_survives` is false, and the static trader prices the trade as losing the whole 5/5.
- [ ] An enemy Banisher swinging into the seat's 0/8 Taunt removes the Taunt in the walk, so the attackers behind it reach the hero. Its hit on a Divine Shield or Indestructible unit removes nothing.
- [ ] Each test also resolves its board through the engine and shows the static read agrees with what `reduce` does.
- [ ] Boards with no Burn, no Toxic and no exile-on-damage source read exactly as before, and `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps the old reads.
- [ ] These pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo jackioh gate`.

## Size and risks

Hard (the AI's rules): about 5 to 8 files, all in `crates/ai`. It needs no engine change, since `burn_on`, `toxic_on`, `hero_burn_of` and `flags_of` are already public reads.

It is independent of the damage-pool suggestion. If both are built, a tick's soak should follow one reading of the pool.

`afflicted` already lowers a doomed unit's worth, so the threat change must not count the same loss twice. The ruling should keep threat and worth as separate terms, as Brittle's are.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43969561832)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix two AI misreads so the static evaluation matches the engine: a unit destroyed by the next tick of its own Burn/Toxic before its controller's next attacks counts as gone in `face_threat` and `could_attack_next_turn`; and a hit from a source with `exiles_on_damage` (Meditative #72 The Banisher) is read as removal everywhere the AI reads Poisonous, priced as an exile (the whole unit, no Death, no Reborn body). Both reads sit behind new `AI_EVAL` flags that stay off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, with rulings R4065000/R4065001, proving tests, and two `spec/pending/4065.md` paragraphs.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Two `EvalWeights` flags `affliction_kills_before_swing`, `exile_on_damage_read` with docs; `AI_EVAL` sets both true; `GREEDY_EVAL` sets both false |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | New `afflicted_before_swing`; `face_threat_from` skip; Taunt walk exile (`soak_past_taunts`, `breaks_alone`, `falls_to_first_strike`, `TauntStand.exiled`); new `exile_worth` |
| `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` | change | `Exchange.exiles`; `blow` gains `exiling` param, `Blow` gains `exiled`; `kills_and_survives` both directions; `could_attack_next_turn` clause; import `flags_of` |
| `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` | change | `fight` threads exile, `Fight` gains `dies_exiled`; `trade_value` prices exile via `exile_worth` (target, attacker, splash); import `flags_of` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs` | new | `r4065000_*` tests: threat counts, armor/Toxic, shield/Indestructible/own-turn, Reborn, stand-downs, greedy parity, engine agreement |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/exile.rs` | new | `r4065001_*` tests: Taunt walk, move order, shield/Indestructible/zero rule, Reborn/Death, greedy parity, engine agreement |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | Add `pub mod affliction_threat;` and `pub mod exile;` (alphabetical) |
| `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` `#[cfg(test)]` mods | change | `r4065001_*` unit tests for `blow`, `kills_and_survives`, `fight`, `trade_value` (private fns integration tests cannot reach) |
| `spec/rulings/R4065000.md`, `spec/rulings/R4065001.md` | new | Ruling notes with `proven_in` listing the new test files (plus the two `src` files for R4065001) |
| `spec/pending/4065.md` | new | The two §11 paragraphs |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Extend the face-threat paragraph and the Burn/Toxic paragraph with the two reads and their flags |

Governing spec/rulings: §4.4 step 7, §4.5 step 1, §6.3 Burn/Toxic, §9.9; R1124 (exile), R3540001 (tick order), R3793000 (pattern to copy), R3822000 (worth/threat separation, learned-features freeze).

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/config.rs`: flags.** Add to `EvalWeights` beside `brittle_crumbles_before_swing`: `pub affliction_kills_before_swing: bool` (doc: R4065000; threat/pressure/`wall_switches`/`stands_down` leave out a unit its own next tick destroys) and `pub exile_on_damage_read: bool` (doc: R4065001; combat reads treat an exiling hit like Poisonous). Set both `true` in `AI_EVAL`, both `false` in `GREEDY_EVAL`. All existing test literals use `..AI_EVAL`, so nothing else breaks.
2. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: `afflicted_before_swing`.** Add `pub(crate) fn afflicted_before_swing(state, unit, view, on_turn_swings) -> bool` after `crumbles_before_swing`. Return false when `burn_on` and `toxic_on` are both 0, when the view has Indestructible, or when `state.active == unit.controller && on_turn_swings` (same timing rule as Brittle: the side swinging now attacks before its next tick). Otherwise simulate exactly the first tick as the engine runs it (R3540001) and as `afflicted` reads it: `shield` starts as Divine Shield unspent; if Burn > 0, it pops the shield or deals `min(cap, max(burn - armor, 0))`; then if Toxic > 0, it pops the shield or deals `min(cap, toxic)` piercing; true when the total reaches `view.health`. No `brittle_due_by` equivalent (every controller start ticks); no extra-turn math (a later start only ticks again). An unspent Reborn does not save it (decision: mirrors R3793000's not-modelled clause; threat and worth stay separate).
3. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: threat skip.** In `face_threat_from`, after the `crumbles_before_swing` continue, add `if w.affliction_kills_before_swing && afflicted_before_swing(state, unit, &view, on_turn_swings) { continue; }`.
4. **`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`: `could_attack_next_turn`.** Add `&& !(AI_EVAL.affliction_kills_before_swing && afflicted_before_swing(state, enemy, &view, false))` to the existing conjunction (precedent: the Brittle clause reads `AI_EVAL` directly). Import `flags_of` from `jackioh_engine`.
5. **`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`: exile plumbing.** Add `pub exiles: bool` to `Exchange`; set it in `exchange()` to `AI_EVAL.exile_on_damage_read && flags_of(state, attacker).exiles_on_damage == Some(true)` (search-only path; GREEDY never reaches it). Change `blow` to `pub(crate) fn blow(from: &Side, amount: i32, poisonous: bool, exiling: bool, to: &Side) -> Blow`; kills becomes `dealt >= to.view.health || (poisonous && dealt > 0) || (exiling && dealt > 0)`; add `pub(crate) exiled: bool` set to `exiling && dealt > 0` at the kills line (shield/Indestructible/zero-rule early returns already yield `exiled: false`). Update the doc comment. `Side` is unchanged.
6. **`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`: `kills_and_survives`.** Compute `let exiling = AI_EVAL.exile_on_damage_read && flags_of(state, attacker).exiles_on_damage == Some(true);` and `let defender_exiles = AI_EVAL.exile_on_damage_read && flags_of(state, target).exiles_on_damage == Some(true);`. Kills: `dealt >= t.health || combat.poisonous || exiling`. Dies: pass `defender_exiles` as the strike-back blow's `exiling`. Everything else (First Strike, shield, Indestructible, `taken <= 0`, Poisonous strike-back) is untouched, so shielded/Indestructible/fully-armored targets still stop exile.
7. **`crates/ai/src/reply.rs`: `fight` and `trade_value`.** Import `flags_of`. `Fight` gains `pub(crate) dies_exiled: bool`. In `fight`: `out = blow(&a, combat.hit, combat.poisonous, combat.exiles, &t)`; dies blow gets `AI_EVAL.exile_on_damage_read && flags_of(state, target).exiles_on_damage == Some(true)`; record its `.exiled` as `dies_exiled`. In `trade_value`: kills branch uses `exile_worth(target)` when `out.exiled` else `kill_worth(target)`; dies branch subtracts `exile_worth(attacker)` when `dies_exiled` else `kill_worth(attacker)`; Cleave splash adds `cleave_share * exile_worth(neighbour)` when `splash.exiled`, else the existing `unit_worth`/shield terms.
8. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`: `exile_worth` + Taunt walk.** Add `pub fn exile_worth(state, unit, w, prices) -> f64 { unit_worth(state, unit, w, prices) }` after `kill_worth` with a doc (the whole unit: the Death share inside stays lost, no payout subtracted, no Reborn body credited). In `soak_past_taunts`, per attacker compute `let exiling = w.exile_on_damage_read && flags_of(state, attacker).exiles_on_damage == Some(true);` (flags_of is already imported). Pass `exiling` to the splash `blow` and use it for the main hit. Add `let mut exiled = false;` beside `poisoned`; set `exiled = exiling` where `poisoned` is set (past the `dealt <= 0` guard). Extend the three `|| poisoned` conditions (loop guard, `unbound.extend(stopped)` gate, Reborn-body gate) with `|| exiled`, except the Reborn gate becomes `&& !exiled` (an exiled Taunt never comes back). Add `exiled: bool` to `TauntStand`, `false` in `of`. In the splash-neighbour kill branch: `if splash.exiled { stands.remove(j) }` before the Reborn check. Add `w: &EvalWeights` to `breaks_alone` (true also when `w.exile_on_damage_read`, dealt > 0, and the attacker exiles) and to `falls_to_first_strike` (the Taunt's own exile flag joins its `poisonous || dealt >= health` kill condition); update both call sites.
9. **Tests, new files.** `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs` and `crates/ai/tests/ai/exile.rs`, following `brittle.rs` (scenario + `LIBRARY`, `register_cards`, `find_instance_mut` for counters, `grant`-style helper copied from `cleave.rs:23`, `act` for engine cross-checks, `face_threat`/`face_threat_with`/`damage_past_taunts`/`stands_down`/`candidate_actions`). Scenario JSON sets counters via `"counters": {"burn": N}` / `{"toxic": N}` (precedent `decide.rs:1251`); Armor via `Keyword::Armor` grant (check the variant shape in `catalog_types.rs` first). Register both mods in `tests/ai/mod.rs`.
10. **Docs.** Write `spec/rulings/R4065000.md` (tick-kills-before-swing: first-tick read, timing, Reborn-still-gone decision, threat/worth split, rejected: extending `can_swing`, reusing the first-tick horizon for worth) and `R4065001.md` (exile read: every site, exile pricing, shield/Indestructible/zero-rule stops, Radiant Cleave splash, rejected: subtracting anything for Death/Reborn), each with `proven_in` (the new test files; R4065001 also `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`). Write `spec/pending/4065.md` in the `pending/4039.md` style (`**[[R4065000]] … (issue #4065, 2026-11-16)**: …`). Extend the two `crates/ai/README.md` paragraphs (face-threat/Brittle and Burn/Toxic).
11. **Checks.** `cargo test -p jackioh-ai <each new test>`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`. Do not run workspace-wide suites (CI owns them).

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs`: `r4065000_burn_five_kills_before_it_swings` (enemy 4/4 Burn 5 + 3/3, seat 7 life: `face_threat` 3; Burn 3 control: 7; `OFF`/`GREEDY_EVAL`: 7; engine `EndTurn` puts the burned unit in the graveyard and leaves the 3/3); `r4065000_armor_meets_burn_but_not_toxic` (4/4 Armor 2 Burn 5 still counts; Toxic 4 does not; engine agrees); `r4065000_shield_indestructible_and_own_turn_still_count` (Divine Shield / Indestructible Burn-5 4/4s count; on-turn-with-`NextSwing::Seat` equals `OFF`, mirroring `brittle.rs` case (a)); `r4065000_reborn_still_reads_as_gone` (unspent-Reborn Burn-5 4/4 adds 0 threat; engine run shows its id left the field); `r4065000_crumbling_enemy_stands_nothing_down` (seat 4/4 vs burning enemy 4/4: no `stands_down`; control: stand-down); `r4065000_greedy_and_clean_boards_read_as_before` (`GREEDY_EVAL` and no-counter boards equal).
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/exile.rs`: `r4065001_banisher_removes_a_taunt_in_the_walk` (enemy Banisher + 8/8 vs seat 0/8 Taunt: threat 8; plain-2/1 control via `statsOverride` Oomen: 0; `OFF`/GREEDY: old reads; engine run exiles the Taunt); `r4065001_banisher_into_shield_or_indestructible_binds` (Divine Shield / Indestructible Taunt stands, nothing reaches the hero); `r4065001_hero_attack_outranks_the_trap_kill` (`candidate_actions`: hero attack before the 5/5-into-Banisher attack); `r4065001_reborn_and_death_agree_with_the_engine` (Banisher exiles a Death unit with no trigger and a Reborn unit with no body; `trade_value` equals `exile_worth` whole); `r4065001_greedy_and_clean_boards_read_as_before`.
- `candidates.rs` `#[cfg(test)]`: `r4065001_a_five_five_does_not_survive_the_banisher` (`kills_and_survives` false vs Banisher, true vs plain 2/1); `r4065001_blow_exiles_only_what_it_damages` (shield / Indestructible / fully-armored target: `exiled` false; 1+ damage: `kills` + `exiled` true). Update existing `blow` call sites (lines ~1197–1301) for the new param.
- `reply.rs` `#[cfg(test)]`: `r4065001_the_static_trader_prices_the_trade_as_an_exile` (`fight` dies + `dies_exiled`; `trade_value` equals `exile_worth(target)` minus `exile_worth(attacker)`, negative; splash `exiled` prices `exile_worth(neighbour)`).
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4065000`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4065001`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` (full crate), `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Burn-5 4/4 beside a 3/3 reads threat 3 (7 with Burn 3); Armor-2 Burn-5 counts; Toxic-4 does not; shielded, Indestructible, and on-turn-swinging units count; Reborn-unspent doomed unit reads 0; `stands_down`/`wall_switches` follow.
- [ ] 5/5 into Banisher is not a surviving kill and prices as losing the whole 5/5; enemy Banisher removes a 0/8 Taunt in the walk; shield/Indestructible/zero-rule stop exile; no Death fires and no Reborn body returns.
- [ ] Every new test also steps the board through the engine (`act`/`EndTurn`) and asserts the static read agrees.
- [ ] No-Burn/no-Toxic/no-exile boards read bit-for-bit as before; `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps the old reads (dedicated tests).
- [ ] Ruling notes, `proven_in` lists, and `spec/pending/4065.md` paragraphs exist; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] Full `jackioh-ai` test run, clippy with `-D warnings`, and `cargo fmt --check` are green.

## Risks

- `face_threat` feeds the learned features; changing its inputs without a refit repeats the R3793000 pattern (accepted there and documented in the ruling; R3822000's freeze stays: counters themselves are still not features).
- `afflicted` still prices worth while threat drops to 0: no double counting by construction (threat and worth are separate terms, as with Brittle), pinned by the greedy-parity test.
- New struct fields/params (`Exchange.exiles`, `blow`'s param, `TauntStand.exiled`, `Fight.dies_exiled`, `w` on `breaks_alone`/`falls_to_first_strike`) must hit every literal and call site; clippy + full-crate tests catch strays.
- Extra-turn timing for afflictions is deliberately dumber than Brittle's (every start ticks): worst case a doomed unit is counted, i.e. today's behavior.

## Open questions

None. The one judgment the issue left open (unspent Reborn on a tick-doomed unit) is settled above as a ruling decision with the alternative recorded; everything else follows the cited rulings and code.
```
